title: 06b-A T2: composeArcSummary error and empty-input tests
description:
Objective:
Extend the arcSummary test suite with two failure-mode tests: ModelClientError from the provider propagates out of composeArcSummary unchanged, and an empty recaps[] argument throws MemorySummaryError before any model call. Add the empty-input validation to the implementation.

Files:
- Modify: packages/core/test/arcSummary.test.ts
- Modify: packages/core/src/memory/arcSummary.ts

Steps:
1. Add the two tests in Design to packages/core/test/arcSummary.test.ts (imports gain ModelClientError and MemorySummaryError from '../src/index.js').
2. Run: npx vitest run packages/core/test/arcSummary.test.ts --reporter=verbose
   Expected: 1 PASS (ModelClientError propagation already works since await re-throws), 1 FAIL (empty-recaps test — no validation yet, function calls model with empty content).
3. Add the validation block in Design to composeArcSummary in packages/core/src/memory/arcSummary.ts (import MemorySummaryError from './summary.js'; throw on empty recaps before building messages).
4. Run the same vitest command.
   Expected: all 4 tests in this file PASS.
5. Run: npm run typecheck
   Expected: success.
6. Commit:
     git add packages/core/test/arcSummary.test.ts packages/core/src/memory/arcSummary.ts
     git commit -m "Validate composeArcSummary inputs and cover error paths (loreweaver-4ua)"
acceptance_criteria:
1. packages/core/test/arcSummary.test.ts contains exactly 4 tests (2 happy + 2 failure) and all pass.
2. composeArcSummary throws MemorySummaryError synchronously-after-await for empty recaps[].
3. ModelClientError from the provider propagates out of composeArcSummary unchanged.
4. npm run typecheck succeeds.
5. The commit message references loreweaver-4ua.
